description: Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones running MIUI or HyperOS.

packages.name: Analytics
packages.breaks: Nothing you would notice.

packages.name: MSA (system ads)
packages.what: Shows adverts inside Xiaomi's own apps.
packages.breaks: Adverts in system apps stop.

packages.name: MSA (system ads)
packages.what: Shows adverts inside Xiaomi's own apps.
packages.breaks: Adverts in system apps stop.

packages.name: MSA (system ads)
packages.what: Older name of Xiaomi's advert service.
packages.breaks: Adverts in system apps stop.

packages.name: Feedback
packages.breaks: You cannot send feedback to Xiaomi from the phone.

packages.name: Services and feedback
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Mi Video
packages.breaks: Videos open in another player or Gallery.

packages.name: Mi Music
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Mi Browser
packages.breaks: If it is your default browser, pick another first.

packages.name: Quick apps
packages.what: Runs mini apps without installing them.
packages.breaks: Quick apps stop opening.

packages.name: Quick apps accessory
packages.breaks: Nothing outside Quick apps.

packages.name: Games
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Compass
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: ShareMe
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Wallpaper Carousel
packages.what: Rotating lock-screen wallpapers with promoted content.
packages.breaks: The lock-screen wallpaper stops rotating.

packages.name: Quick ball
packages.breaks: The floating Quick ball is unavailable.

packages.name: Mi Roaming
packages.breaks: Only this app goes away until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Mi Remote
packages.breaks: You cannot use the phone as a TV remote.

packages.name: Mi Mover
packages.what: Moves data from an old phone.
packages.breaks: You cannot transfer data with Mi Mover until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Joyose
packages.breaks: Game Turbo features and some thermal tuning may change.

packages.name: MIUI Daemon
packages.breaks: Usually nothing; on some versions battery statistics screens misbehave.

packages.name: GetApps
packages.breaks: Xiaomi's own apps stop updating through GetApps.

packages.name: Yellow pages
packages.breaks: Caller ID for unknown business numbers stops.

packages.name: Cleaner
packages.what: Storage cleaner inside the Security app.
packages.breaks: The Cleaner button in the Security app stops working.

packages.name: Weather
packages.breaks: Weather widgets go blank.

packages.name: Notes
packages.breaks: Your notes cannot be opened until it is switched back on.

packages.name: Calculator
packages.breaks: No calculator unless another one is installed.

packages.name: FM radio
packages.breaks: FM radio is unavailable.

packages.name: Mi Pay
packages.breaks: Mi Pay stops working.

packages.name: Mi Pay (India)
packages.breaks: Mi Pay stops working.

packages.name: App vault
packages.what: The page left of the home screen.
packages.breaks: The App vault page disappears; some home-screen widgets go with it.

packages.name: Screen recorder
packages.breaks: Screen recording from the control centre stops working.

packages.name: Mi Share
packages.breaks: Mi Share stops working.

packages.name: Scanner
packages.breaks: The scanner shortcut stops working.

packages.name: Application extension service
packages.what: Lets system apps read on-screen content for features.
packages.breaks: Some smart features in Xiaomi apps stop.

packages.name: Gallery
packages.breaks: The camera's preview button and photo pickers in other apps may break.

packages.name: Xiaomi Cloud
packages.what: Sync of contacts, messages and photos.
packages.breaks: Xiaomi Cloud sync stops; Settings pages may crash.

packages.name: Xiaomi Cloud backup
packages.what: Backs up the phone to Xiaomi Cloud.
packages.breaks: Cloud backups stop.

packages.name: Xiaomi Cloud sync
packages.breaks: Xiaomi Cloud sync stops.

packages.name: Xiaomi account
packages.breaks: Mi account features break, including Find Device and unlocking after a reset.

packages.name: System app updater
packages.breaks: Xiaomi system apps stop receiving updates.

packages.name: SIM activation service
packages.what: Registers the SIM for Xiaomi services.
packages.breaks: Find Device and Mi messaging features may fail.
